review_method: Authored by Codex coverage_remaining/mm_remaining; independently reviewed against exact final source by Codex coverage_engine and Codex root on 2026-10-29. Plaque model scale and original-pixel resize semantics, distinct legacy defaults, names and numbers are preserved.

records.source: Expected object diameter in pixels. Plaque Assay starts at 0, which uses the model's own scale; positive values are measured in original input-image pixels and adjusted when wells are resized. Legacy mask-finetune and check_cellpose_models pass it to model.eval(diameter=...). Prefer per-object diameter settings in other modules. Default 30 for mask-finetune; check_cellpose_models starts at 40.
records.translation: Diâmetro esperado do objeto em píxeis. Plaque Assay começa com 0, que utiliza a escala própria do modelo; os valores positivos são expressos em píxeis da imagem de entrada original e ajustados quando as imagens dos poços são redimensionadas. As ferramentas antigas mask-finetune e check_cellpose_models passam este valor a model.eval(diameter=...). Nos outros módulos, prefira as definições de diâmetro para cada tipo de objeto. Valor predefinido 30 para mask-finetune; check_cellpose_models começa com 40.
